Who it serves

Find parking near you, and back up the dashcam drives you already record.

Buyers, in the order we'd call them
AppyWayHolds the UK kerb-restriction map; resells to councils
Arrive · ParkopediaReceipt feed into Parkopedia availability
APCOAGarage cameras don't see the kerb
Nextbase + Geopost VisionDashcams on parcel vans keep the map fresh
Westminster City CouncilOccupancy is still surveyed; a 90-day pilot

Pricing proposed per kerb-km per month, not yet tested

Buyers: team research4 / 5
[1:05-1:35] Drivers get parking near them and a backup of their dashcam drives. The money is in the kerb data: AppyWay, who hold the UK kerb map and resell to councils; Arrive through Parkopedia; APCOA, whose garage cameras can't see the street; Nextbase with Geopost Vision, whose cameras on parcel vans keep the map fresh; and Westminster, which still surveys occupancy. Pricing is proposed per kerb-kilometre per month; we haven't tested it with a buyer yet.

Kerb Map · Team 55 / 5
[1:35-2:00] Under the hood: a dashcam drive is uploaded into VAST storage; YOLO and NVIDIA Cosmos run on VAST to find parked cars and gaps; the free and taken spaces are stored in VastDB; and the app serves the nearest free ones on demand. All built today, on the organisers' supplied Toronto drives. Built today on VAST, NVIDIA Cosmos and Nemotron, CoreWeave GPUs, W&B Inference and Weave, with Cursor agents. Thank you.
